description: Buy a credit top-up or upgrade the plan directly, charging the account's saved card. Requires an API key. This charges the saved card only if the human enabled agent purchases and set a monthly cap in the Ujeebu dashboard (Billing); agent purchases are off by default. Otherwise (purchases disabled, no saved card, over the monthly cap, card declined, or extra verification required) it returns an error with a checkout_url: hand that link to your human instead. Never retry a declined charge in a loop. Check ujeebu_plans first for prices and the remaining monthly cap. Downgrades and cancellations are not possible via agents.

interval.description: Billing interval for kind=plan only. Default: month. Ignored for top-ups.

item.description: Id of the top-up or plan, as listed by ujeebu_plans (e.g. 'mini' for a top-up, 'starter' for a plan).

kind.description: 'topup' for a one-off credit pack (credits never expire) or 'plan' for a subscription upgrade.

name: ujeebu_buy
